newsitem.title: ITALY: Pope back on his feet after surgery - doctor.
newsitem.headline: Pope back on his feet after surgery - doctor.

text.p: Pope John Paul was back on his feet on Wednesday, 24 hours after an operation to remove his appendix, one of his doctors said.
"He (the Pope) spoke with us and he strolled around the corridors of his suite," Professor Luigi Ortona, a senior member of the Pope's medical team, told Reuters. "Everything is fine."
An official medical bulletin on the Pope's condition was expected at noon (1000 GMT).

The Pontiff, 76, was recuperating at Rome's Gemelli Hospital after Tuesday's operation. Doctors said the surgery was a success and showed the Roman Catholic leader was not suffering from another tumour.
The Polish-born Pope had an intestinal tumour removed in 1992.
The Vatican has said the operation was needed after the Pope suffered three bouts of fever since Christmas caused by recurrent inflammation of the appendix.
